Introduction. The Maypole is a seasonal structure that can be built exclusively during the midsummer season. It also can be found rarely in the middle of Abandoned Villages within the Meadows. Its sole purpose is to increase Comfort by 1.

Availability. Maypoles generate during world generation. One or more can be found in a world. They will not respawn once destroyed.
From 1 June – 6 July, Maypoles are made temporarily buildable to celebrate Midsummer and then unbuildable the rest of the year. Player-placed Maypoles function identically to the natural ones and remain in the world after the Midsummer season has ended.
